content.doc_md:
## Tutorials

The Round() function rounds a number to a specified number of decimal places.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ProductName, Price, Round(Price, 1) AS RoundedPrice
FROM Products;

---

Round(
expression
,
decimal_places
)
```

## Tutorials

The Sgn() function returns the sign of a number.

This function will return one of the following:

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Sgn(243.5) AS SgnNum;

---

Sgn(
number
)
```

## Tutorials

The Sqr() function returns the square root of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Sqr(64) AS SqrNum;

---

Sqr(
number
)
```

## Tutorials

The Sum() function calculates the sum of a set of values.

Note:NULL values are ignored.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Sum(Quantity) AS TotalItemsOrdered FROM OrderDetails;

---

Sum(
expression
)
```

## Tutorials

The Val() function reads a string and returns the numbers found in the string.

Note:This function stops reading once it 
encounters a NON-numeric character.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Val(PostalCode) FROM Customers;

---

Val(
string
)
```
